name: bánánach
text: bánánach names preternatural female beings of early Irish literature. They appear above the field of battle, marking the carnage in the manner of the war-furies of older tradition. The MacKillop entry cross-references the badb and the bocánach, two related battle-haunting figures of early Irish lore.

attributes.attribute: Preternatural female beings of early Irish literature who appear over the field of battle.

okr.objective: Document bánánach as battle-haunting female beings in early Irish literature.
key_results: Cross-references Badb and bocánach as related figures.
